requirements_summary: Workload: real-time customer support chat (agent assist + auto-respond) with tool calls into ticketing and knowledge base.
Latency: First-token SLO <1.5s (US-EAST); 95th pct latency budget <800ms for shortest-turn messages.
Throughput: avg 80-120 req/s during peak; concurrency spiky up to ~400 concurrent sessions during promos.
Streaming: mandatory for UI — want partial responses as generated; progress indicators important.
Tool calling: must support secure function/tool calling for ticket ops (create/update/search) and external KB retrieval; audit trail required.
Model preferences: open models preferred for auditability; fallbacks to quantized variants acceptable; need Redwood model catalog performance profiles.
Routing/fallback: prefer smart routing to lower-cost variants during non-peak, automatic fallback to compatible models on capacity pressure.
Data controls: retention controls, optional data residency in EU, KMS for DB keys, audit logging to SIEM.
Rollout: canary on 5% traffic, A/B evaluation vs existing vendor for 2 weeks, automatic rollback criteria defined.
poc_plan: Week 0: baseline telemetry capture from current vendor (latency, token counts, error rates).
Week 1: Hosted API POC — integrate streaming + tool calls with 50 agent seats; synthetic load test to validate first-token SLO.
Week 2: Real traffic shadowing (no auto-respond) -> measure tail latency and resource usage; run cost simulation.
Measurement: collect per-token cost, per-request latency percentiles, streaming connection stability, kv-cache hit rates.
Deliverable: demo for execs + POC report with Recommended config (batching, cache TTL, quantization) and Dedicated sizing estimate.
